items.statement: A source-bounded evidence-supported answer to: What molecular explanation can be supported for the absorption and emission of arene-fused o-carborane2a in THF solution? Investigate the relevant electronic/structural description and establish which assignments are robust or remain unresolved.
items.expected: Accept scientifically defensible alternative methods and evidence-supported support, refutation or unresolved answers. Judge sufficiency for the actual question and claims; do not require any retired V1 matrix, author winner, fixed hypothesis count or particular software. Full points require linked genuine artifacts that sustain the claim; partial points scale with valid question coverage; absent/invalid evidence receives zero dependent credit. Missing research cannot establish non-identifiability. The task concerns solution molecular photophysics. Do not claim the solid-state539nm band, aggregation-induced emission, fluorescence quantum yield or the causal effect of fusion relative to a different molecule from these finite results alone. Precursor1a differs by Br/H composition and is not a chemically matched geometry-only control.
